shortDescription: Add and remove Switches from a DCNM managed VXLAN fabric.

options.name: config
options.description: List of switches being managed. Not required for state deleted

options.name: deploy
options.description: Deploy the pending configuration of the fabric after inventory is updated

options.name: fabric
options.description: Name of the target fabric for Inventory operations

options.name: query_poap
options.description: Query for Bootstrap(POAP) capable switches available.

options.name: save
options.description: Save/Recalculate the configuration of the fabric after the inventory is updated

options.name: state
options.description: The state of DCNM after module completion. I(merged) and I(query) are the only states supported for POAP. I(merged) is the only state supported for RMA.
